notes: ui-styling is a model-invocable implementation guide for shadcn/ui (Radix + Tailwind) on React-based frameworks (Next.js, Vite, Remix, Astro). Evals verify the implementation mechanics: npx shadcn@latest init/add, components owned in components/ui/, React Hook Form + Zod forms, next-themes dark mode with paired light/dark: variants, mobile-first breakpoints, and semantic tokens (no dynamic class names). Skip When the stack is Vue, React Native/Flutter, or non-Tailwind CSS.

evals.prompt: Add shadcn/ui to my Next.js app and build a login form with email/password validation.
evals.expected_output: Runs npx shadcn@latest init then add form input button, scaffolds a LoginForm using React Hook Form + zodResolver with a Zod schema (email + min-8 password), wires FormField/FormMessage for inline errors, and keeps components under components/ui/. Uses semantic tokens and accessible labels.

evals.prompt: Set up dark mode for our Vite + Tailwind dashboard and make the card grid responsive.
evals.expected_output: Configures Tailwind darkMode: 'class', adds a next-themes ThemeProvider (attribute="class") and a Sun/Moon ThemeToggle, and builds a mobile-first responsive grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3). Pairs every themed element with a dark: variant and uses HSL CSS-variable tokens rather than hardcoded hex.

evals.prompt: Style my Vue 3 app's navbar and dialog with Vuetify.
evals.expected_output: Should not fire, because ui-styling's Skip When excludes Vue.js (use Vuetify/Nuxt UI patterns) — the skill is scoped to shadcn/ui + Tailwind on React-based frameworks.
